-- Deterministic validation of the curated sample CSV using the serverless SQL pool.
-- No credentials are embedded: OPENROWSET relies on the workspace's managed identity /
-- delegated AAD access already granted (Storage Blob Data Reader) on the ADLS account.
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customer_ids,
    SUM(CASE WHEN customer_id IS NULL OR customer_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_key_rows
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK '{{STORAGE_ACCOUNT_DFS_ENDPOINT}}/curated/sample/sample_customers.csv',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    FIRSTROW = 2
) WITH (
    customer_id   VARCHAR(50) 1,
    customer_name VARCHAR(200) 2,
    region        VARCHAR(50) 3,
    signup_date   VARCHAR(20) 4
) AS curated_rows;
